tools.assemble: tools/assemble-source-image.py (--source-tree as WSL root, --stage, --build, --readback as WSL root)

selection.rule: path level: a factory path the Source image does not contain is carried unless excluded below; a path present in both keeps the Source file unless listed in factory_over_source or generated; package level: a package name present in both keeps the Source APK unless listed in packages_factory_over_source; Source-only packages absent from the factory image are dropped (the factory package set is mirrored)

exclude_factory.system/apex/**: the Source APEXes (runtime/ART, conscrypt, media, resolv, tzdata) are used
exclude_factory.system/etc/selinux/**: the Source platform SELinux policy (factory parity, validation/sepolicy-parity.json) is used
exclude_factory.**/oat/**: factory odex/vdex/art were compiled against the factory boot image; the Source boot image differs, carried APKs are compiled on the device at first boot
exclude_factory.system/bin/install-recovery.sh: trial only: the system image must not rewrite the recovery partition (the offline recovery can stay installed between trial iterations)
exclude_factory.system/pre_resource/sdcard/pre_resource/: size: the Source components (debug runtime APEX, larger libraries) add ~80 MiB over the factory content and the factory image had only 53 MiB free in the fixed 5704732672-byte logical system; this 300 MiB 8K demo video (copied to /sdcard on first run) is the only file dropped for space
exclude_factory.system/priv-app/SystemUpdate2/**: replaced by the Source Update app (device/pico/PICOA8110/source-update): same package com.picovr.updatesystem and components, installs signed Source OTA packages; the factory app would offer PICO firmware over Source

factory_over_source.system/usr/keylayout/Generic.kl: PICO controller keys (LCONTROLLER_HOME, RCONTROLLER_HOME, CAMERA, GESTURE_CALIBRATION)
factory_over_source.system/etc/fonts.xml: factory font configuration referencing the carried PICOSans fonts
factory_over_source.system/bin/toybox: factory toybox: PICO applets and options without source (gtop GPU top over /proc/gpu_procs, run by SysPerfMonitorService every 10 s; top OOMS/OOMSJ/OOMJ fields; f2fs pin; swap); same NEEDED libraries as the Source toybox

packages_factory_over_source.com.android.packageinstaller: factory PicoPackageInstaller (priv-app/PicoPackageInstaller) replaces the Source PackageInstaller as on 5.13.7
packages_factory_over_source.com.android.permissioncontroller: factory PICO PermissionController renders runtime permission prompts in VR (VrGrantPermissionsActivity, PicoGrantPermissionsViewHandlerImpl, SurfaceProxy); the AOSP one shows invisible 2D dialogs (outputs/audit/config.md PKG-01)
packages_factory_over_source.com.android.providers.settings: factory PICO SettingsProvider: initPicoSettings (force_resizable_activities=1, animation scales 0, safe_boot_disallowed), PICO defaults (screen_off_timeout -1, brightness 201, lockscreen disabled, immersive confirmed), stabd restore notification (outputs/audit/config.md SET-01..06)
packages_factory_over_source.com.android.networkstack.inprocess: factory PICO InProcessNetworkStack (PICO TCP/slardar reporting strings, outputs/audit/config.md section 4)

selection.drop_source_packages_reason: package absent from the factory 5.13.7 system/product/vendor/odm; not installed on the trial image so the package set equals the factory one

drop_source_files.system/apex/com.android.apex.cts.shim.ap: CTS shim APEX of updatable_apex.mk, absent from factory

signing.rule: every carried factory system APK signed with a PICO role certificate is re-signed with the Source key of the same role (v1+v2, Source apksigner); other certificates are kept
signing.shadow_reason: android.uid.system members on the unchanged product partition: framework-res (scanned first) fixes the shared user certificate to the Source platform key, a later PICO-signed member fails with INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_INCONSISTENT_CERTIFICATES. A re-signed copy on /system is scanned before /product; the product copy is then skipped as a duplicate package
signing.mac_permissions_reason: trial only: apps left with the PICO certificate on product/vendor (android.uid.phone group, QTI product apps, vendor TimeService) keep the seinfo they had on 5.13.7; the entries are copied from the factory plat_mac_permissions.xml

generated.system/build.prop: Source build.prop + factory-only properties + trial identity (below)
generated.system/etc/public.libraries.txt: Source list + factory PICO/QTI public libraries
generated.system/etc/vintf/manifest.xml: Source framework manifest + factory-only HALs served from system

system/bin/trial-snapshot.sh.reason: trial only: snapshots at 1, 3 and 7 minutes (props, processes, dmesg, SurfaceFlinger/window/activity/usb/adb) on /cache and Settings.Global.adb_enabled=1

adb_keys.reason: trial only: adbd (system/core/adb/daemon/auth.cpp) trusts /adb_keys besides /data/misc/adb/adb_keys; the public ADB key of the project PC lets adb work after a userdata wipe although the factory vendor/default.prop forces ro.adb.secure=1

reasons.ro.build.version.security_patch: kept at the factory 2021-04-05 like preview 01: equals the boot header SPL (2021-04) that the kept boot passes to Keymaster; the real Source base SPL is ro.pico.aosp.base_spl
reasons.persist.logd.logpersistd*: trial only: logcatd keeps up to 1024 x 1 MiB rotated logcat files in /data/misc/logd
reasons.persist.logd.size: trial only: 16 MiB logd ring buffers
reasons.persist.sys.disable_rescue: trial only: RescueParty must not send a crashing system_server to recovery with a wipe prompt
reasons.ro.adb.secure: trial only: adbd without key authorization (userdebug, ro.debuggable=1, persist.sys.usb.config=adb); overridden on the device by the factory vendor/default.prop ro.adb.secure=1, see extra_files adb_keys
reasons.ro.logd.kernel: factory prop.default value: logd collects the kernel log
reasons.ro.source.version: Source release number (1.01, 1.02, ...); tools/source-ota.py reads it to pick the update base
